issue_context.title: CSV `count_rows` does not skip empty lines at file start
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

Using this file:
```python

a,b
1,1

```

```python
import polars as pl

path = ".env/data.csv"
lf = pl.scan_csv(path)
print(lf.collect())
print(lf.collect().height)
print(lf.select(pl.len()).collect())

```

Prints:
```python
shape: (1, 2)
┌─────┬─────┐
│ a   ┆ b   │
│ --- ┆ --- │
│ i64 ┆ i64 │
╞═════╪═════╡
│ 1   ┆ 1   │
└─────┴─────┘

┌─────┐
│ len │
│ --- │
│ u32 │
╞═════╡
│ 2   │
└─────┘
```

### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

Empty lines at file start were incorrectly counted

### Expected behavior

It should print that `pl.len()` is 1 instead of 2

### Installed versions

1.4.1
